verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a programmatic surface to build against: a Management API for managing organizations and projects (docs-28), a published OpenAPI spec (probe-3), type-safe API definitions generated from the database (docs-27), and documented ways to connect from frontend, backend, and serverless code (docs-20). None of it explicitly names official client SDKs or language libraries, so the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of official SDKs and their language coverage, SDK reference docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of building with them.
